batch_notes: Inspected the complete 280413-character pilot-c stream in consecutive 16000-character chunks, with the last chunk ending at 280413; every supplied part, row and note was included. No truncated output required rereading.

Dates in the dynasty and colonial-officeholder rosters, museum establishment years, and named prison locations are textual; numerical army strengths, spindle capacities and membership counts remain statistical.

Recurring boundaries: public budgets and debt remain finance despite sector spending headings; school or prisoner nationality breakdowns do not add population; official document counts are administrative activity rather than postal traffic.

Retained geography as context only: population, schools, crime and production in colonial settings do not receive colonial-rule by location alone. Colonial-rule is used for colonial officeholders and the Governor’s administrative machinery.

Three review questions concern an aggregate economic-indicators concept, the scope of charitable-institutions for public social-work facilities, and the Keijo Tramways Company service category. No vocabulary IDs were invented.
